subject: Draft: Exec ops brief + two-phase people transition notice
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Exec ops brief + two-phase people transition notice

Team —

Attached is the first pass of two short items we need cleaned and ready for the QBR packet:

1) Executive ops brief (one pager) that summarizes the proposed change to the Platform org alignment and the rationale for a two-phase transition.
2) The people transition notice (aimed at impacted ICs and managers) — we want this to be clear, empathetic, and to include the timeline and available supports.

Key constraints / asks:
- Tone: factual, supportive, and decisive. Avoid jargon.
- Timeline: draft to me by end of day Wed (2027-03-03). Finalize before leadership review on Thu.
- QBR: we need the one-pager to slot into the QBR appendix (2 slides max). Vivek, please confirm any metrics we should surface.
- Org chart: attached org-chart-v2.png is the recommended structure for phase 1. Please call out who is in scope for phase 1 vs. phase 2.

A few specific questions for review:
- Laura: can you review the wording around manager handoffs? I want to make sure we’re not over-prescriptive.
- Jonas: can you sanity-check the operational risk section and the suggested mitigation timeline?
- Monica: can you coordinate People Ops input and confirm available coaching / transitional support?

I’ve included a draft people notice in two lengths: short (one paragraph) and long (detailed FAQ). Put comments inline — will consolidate.

Thanks — I know this is tight.

— Camila
Camila Reyes
VP, Platform Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: two_phase_handoff.pdf; org-chart-v2.png; qbr-ask-slides.pptx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Exec ops brief + two-phase people transition notice

Camila —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick read and a few inline notes on the PDF (attached). High-level thoughts below.

- Operational risk: the mitigation timeline looks reasonable but I suggest pushing the milestone that requires cross-team code freezes by one week to avoid overlapping with the infra scheduled deploy on Apr 6.
- Phase definitions: phase 1 should explicitly list the teams and owners — right now org-chart-v2.png groups by function, which is fine, but we need a table mapping owners to impacted headcount for the QBR.
- Messaging: the short notice feels right for managers but I think IC-facing language should be softened around timing (avoid exact dates for transfers; use ranges).

I added a paragraph under "fallbacks" that proposes keeping a reserve pool of contractors for 90 days to cover throughput risk. Curious what People Ops thinks.

On the QBR slides: I trimmed a bullet and suggested a single chart with cost impact vs. timeline. I can mock that if you want.

Onward —
Jonas
Head of Product Ops

Camila / Jonas —

I reviewed both drafts and left comments on the long FAQ where we need to be clearer on manager next steps. Two quick suggestions:

1) Add an owner matrix row that says: "Manager responsibility: schedule one 30-minute transition sync within 7 business days, document knowledge transfer in shared drive." Keeps it lightweight and actionable.
2) For the short notice, replace the sentence that says "effective immediately" with "effective the week of April 6" — that gives people a clear window while preserving some flexibility.

Other than those edits, the tone is good. Monica, can People Ops confirm what coaching slots we can offer? We should avoid promising >2 months of paid outplacement unless People Ops has already confirmed.

-Laura
Director, Engineering Programs

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Exec ops brief + two-phase people transition notice

Thanks — I read both and have two asks for the QBR insert:

1) Metrics: please include a slide with estimated RPS/latency headroom impact and expected cost delta (NTE $/month) for phase 1 and phase 2. I can provide conservative numbers if you want.
2) Risk scoring: add a simple 3x3 risk matrix (impact x likelihood) that maps to the mitigation steps. That will help the execs make a fast call.

If you can drop those into qbr-ask-slides.pptx I’ll review before leadership review. Also, for the manager guidance — Laura’s matrix idea works. Monica, can you confirm coaching capacity? If People Ops needs a headcount ask we should raise it in the QBR.

-Vivek
SVP, Product & GTM

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Exec ops brief + two-phase people transition notice

Camila —

People Ops can cover up to: two 1:1 coaching sessions per impacted employee (up to 6 weeks), 3 group transition workshops, and a curated list of recruitment partners for placements. We cannot commit to >60 days paid outplacement unless leadership approves a small one-time fund.

I’ll coordinate a short FAQ addendum that spells this out and link People Ops resources. Also: we recommend offering voluntary internal redeployment conversations before any external postings — helps morale and reduces churn.

I’ll upload the updated qbr-ask-slides.pptx with a resources slide and the coaching capacity numbers by EOD.

— Monica
Head of People Ops

Subject: Final draft for leadership review: Exec ops brief + people notice (for QBR)

Thanks for the fast turnaround — really helpful.

I incorporated:
- Jonas’s suggested timeline shift for the cross-team code freeze (moved +1 week) and the contractor fallback language.
- Laura’s manager action item (30-minute transition sync + KT doc) and softer timing in the short notice.
- Vivek’s request: added a metrics frame and risk matrix to qbr-ask-slides.pptx.
- Monica’s People Ops capacities and the recommendation to open internal redeployment conversations first.

I’ve attached the updated artifacts (two_phase_handoff.pdf, org-chart-v2.png, qbr-ask-slides.pptx). Please treat this as leadership-ready. If there are no objections, I’ll send to the leadership review group at 2pm and request the QBR slot.

Final ask / next steps:
- Please reply with any redlines by 1:30pm today.
- If no redlines, I will send the packet to leadership and copy People Ops for the external comms cadence.

If Emily (Acme) — thanks for staying looped; we aren’t changing our customer SLAs but will coordinate any customer-facing messaging if timelines affect support windows.

— Camila

Redwood Inference
